description: Roman fortress that appears to have become a civilian settlement as early as the 50s or 60s CE. Geophysical surveys identified what appears to be a shrine or temple in the south-western area. Dating unknown.
bibliography: Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Alchester, Vexillation Fortress (Oxfordshire).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
Sauer. “Alchester, a Claudian ‘Vexillation Fortress’ near the Western Boundary of the Catuvellauni: New Light on the Roman Invasion of Britain.” Archaeological Journal 157 (2000).
